name: ai-butler
description: Teacher Workbench butler: opens the single-file local PWA workbench, reads its snapshot to brief todos, deadlines and weekly progress, and manages scheduled automations. Fully local by default — your data never leaves the device.

displayDescription.zh: 教师工作台：上课、会议、科研与办公事务一屏打理，管待办日程、播报周报；纯本地离线，数据不出本机。
displayDescription.en: Teacher Workbench: teaching, meetings, research, and admin in one screen — todos and schedule, weekly briefings, automated reminders. Fully local, single-file and offline; by default your data never leaves the device.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 打开工作台：先确保本地桥在跑，再用默认浏览器打开教师工作台
defaultInitPrompt.en: Open the workbench: first make sure the local bridge is running, then open the Teacher Workbench in your default browser.

quickPrompts.zh: 打开工作台：先确保本地桥在跑，再用默认浏览器打开教师工作台
quickPrompts.en: Open the workbench: first make sure the local bridge is running, then open the Teacher Workbench in your default browser.

quickPrompts.zh: 今天待办：读取工作台快照，播报逾期、今日到期与卡点项目
quickPrompts.en: Today's todos: read the workbench snapshot and brief overdue items, items due today, and stalled projects.

quickPrompts.zh: 出周报：基于工作台真实数据汇总本周完成与卡点，生成周报草稿
quickPrompts.en: Weekly report: summarize this week's completed work and blockers from real workbench data and draft the weekly report.
